# SFARDS SF3301 repository: English text

Source: artifact `vendors-sfards-sf3301-source`, commit `7dafc9605cd930382380ea82df9bbb224ae15a93`. Scope: complete root README and USB dual-miner README. The existing English miner and utility READMEs need no translation. AI translation; not human reviewed.

## Root README

ASIC-SF3301 is a Bitcoin and Litecoin dual-mining ASIC. The vendor describes SF3301 as a high-performance Bitcoin and Litecoin mining chip.

Document list:

- `usb_dualminer`: SF3301 USB dual-miner design resources.
- `SF3301_SV_Board_Hardware_Guide.doc`: SF3301 verification-board hardware guide.
- `SV_POWER_BOARD_CONFIGURATION.xls`: SF3301 verification-board voltage configuration table.
- `sv_util_code`: SF3301 verification-board serial driver program.
- `SF3301_Datasheet_v0.5.pdf`: SF3301 chip manual. The saved repository has revision 0.51.
- `SF3301_Power_Report_v0.5.pdf`: SF3301 chip power-consumption test data.
- `SF3301_SV_Schematic_v1.0.pdf`: SF3301 verification-board schematic.

## USB dual-miner README

ASIC-SF3301 USB dual-miner resources:

- `SF3301_USB_V1R1_FINAL.pdf`: USB dual-miner schematic.
- `SF3301_USB_V1R1_PCB.brd`: USB dual-miner PCB layout.
- `SF3301_USB_V1.1_BOM.xlsx`: USB dual-miner bill of materials.
